content.text:
{
  "dialogue": "Maya: okay finally changed out of work clothes, much better
Me: same, couch uniform on
Maya: i was listening to that food podcast while cooking and they had this dumb line
Maya: they were like "science says if it's Saturday you have to get pizza, sorry we don't make the rules"
Me: lol that's very serious science
Maya: right? i laughed cause their delivery was so serious
Me: what were you cooking, soup again?
Maya: just crackers and soup again, very lazy
Me: same energy here, leftover pasta
Maya: did your mug survive the dishwasher or are you handwashing the art
Me: handwashing, i'm scared it'll crack if i look at it wrong
Maya: precious lopsided baby
Me: exactly, how's miracle basil tonight
Maya: still alive on the windowsill, thriving honestly
Maya: tho my kitchen is still a mess from the oat latte spill this morning
Me: oh no, was it everywhere
Maya: basically, i need to wipe the counter still
Maya: oh random thought, since we're doing Friday
Me: yeah?
Maya: what if we did pizza again that Saturday too? like the 24th, day after?
Maya: just as a maybe if we're free, nothing booked
Me: ahh i can't commit to Saturday yet, work stuff is weird that weekend
Me: let's not book anything for then for now?
Maya: yeah totally just floating it, we can see how Friday goes
Me: yeah Friday first, then we'll see
Maya: that podcast joke got me thinking about weekend pizza lol, not trying to double-book us
Me: lol the Saturday pizza propaganda worked
Maya: seriously, they said it so confidently
Me: are you still doing dairy-free solid? stomach better?
Maya: yeah way less bloated today, sticking with it
Me: nice, glad the oat latte era is working",
  "writer_note": "Kept the podcast line as a quoted joke with attribution, made Saturday the 24th a tentative float that Me explicitly declines to commit to, while leaving the Friday Mario's lunch as the only firm plan amid normal plant/pottery/soup chatter."
}
